blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several bank accounts belonging to Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, Manases Carpio were presented before the Senate impeachment court on Wednesday as the proceedings on Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth continued. On the 35th day of Duterte’s impeachment trial, several bank representatives testified before the court to show Duterte and Carpio’s year-end balances from 2022 to 2025.
